executive_summary: Automated security audit was successfully completed. Review findings and remediation guidelines.

findings.title: SQL Injection in /api/users
findings.description: SQL Injection occurs when untrusted input is directly concatenated into SQL query strings. An attacker can manipulate queries to extract data, modify tables, or execute database administrative operations.
findings.remediation:
1. Use Parameterized Queries: Replace dynamic SQL strings with prepared statements or ORM binding methods (e.g., SQLAlchemy parameters).
2. Apply Input Validation: Use schema validation (like Pydantic) to verify that parameters match expected formats.
3. Principle of Least Privilege: Ensure the database user has minimal necessary permissions.
